## Citi Trends Sets Date for Third Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 29, 2014


[Citi Trends Sets Date for Third Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call](https://ir.cititrends.com/static-files/b643ccc6-c055-434c-bebe-779747650ffe)


SAVANNAH, Ga., Oct. 29, 2014 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Citi Trends, Inc. (Nasdaq:CTRN) today announced details for the release of its results for the third quarter ending November 1, 2014.


Citi Trends plans to release its earnings for the third quarter before the market opens on Tuesday, November 25, 2014. Citi Trends will host a conference call on the same day at 9 a.m. ET. The number to call for the live interactive teleconference is (212) 231-2908. A replay of the conference call will be available until December 2, 2014, by dialing (402) 977-9140 and entering the passcode, 21705728.


The live broadcast of Citi Trends' conference call will be available online at the Company's website,[www.cititrends.com](http://www.globenewswire.com/newsroom/ctr?d=10104923&l=3&a=www.cititrends.com&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.cititrends.com%2F) , as well as[www.cititrends.com/http/ircititrendscom](http://www.globenewswire.com/newsroom/ctr?d=10104923&l=3&a=www.cititrends.com%2Fhttp%2Fircititrendscom&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.cititrends.com%2Fhttp%2Fircititrendscom) , on November 25, 2014, beginning at 9 a.m. ET. The online replay will follow shortly after the call and will be available for replay for one year.


During the conference call, the Company may discuss and answer questions concerning business, financial developments and trends after quarter-end. The Company's responses to questions, as well as other matters discussed during the conference call, may contain or constitute information that has not been disclosed previously.


***About Citi Trends***


Citi Trends, Inc. is a value-priced retailer of urban fashion apparel and accessories for the entire family. The Company operates 510 stores located in 29 states. Citi Trends' website address is[www.cititrends.com](http://www.globenewswire.com/newsroom/ctr?d=10104923&l=6&a=www.cititrends.com&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.cititrends.com%2F) . *CTRN-E*
